info.title: WhatsCRM API
info.description: WhatsApp CRM and automation platform API. Generated from the server's Zod validation schemas.

get.summary: Multi-tenant admin dashboard data (companies, tenants, users, roles, billing, usage, logs, settings).

put.summary: Update workspace/organization settings (security, branding, API keys, billing).

get.summary: Export the full audit trail as CSV, optionally bounded by a date range.

200.description: CSV export of audit log entries.

post.summary: Delete audit log entries older than the workspace's configured retention window.

get.summary: List all feature flags with their effective value, source (override/env-default), and whether they gate real behavior.

put.summary: Set a live override for a feature flag.

delete.summary: Clear a feature flag override, reverting it to its env default.

get.summary: Aggregate analytics for the workspace over a date range (messages, campaigns, agent performance).
Export the analytics summary as CSV.
Export the analytics summary as a PDF report.
AI assistant provider configuration, capabilities, and recent activity.

post.summary: Run an AI analysis task (full analysis, draft reply, etc.) against a conversation.
Stream an AI analysis task as Server-Sent Events.

get.summary: Full-text search across messages and knowledge base entries.

post.summary: Add a knowledge base entry the assistant can draw on.
Record a voice transcription against the assistant's activity log.
Record a voice reply generated by the assistant.
Invoke a named assistant tool (e.g. updateLeadStage) with free-form arguments.

get.summary: Resolve the current session from the bearer token and re-issue a fresh workspace session.

post.summary: Authenticate with email/password and receive a session token.

get.summary: Run history for a flow, including nested sub_workflow child runs.
List automation flows for the workspace.

post.summary: Create a new automation flow.

actionMessage.default: Thanks for reaching out. Our team will reply shortly.

post.summary: Run a flow synchronously in test mode against a sample message.

get.summary: List calendar events, optionally bounded by a from/to range (for the month-grid view).

post.summary: Create a calendar event.

get.summary: List campaigns for the workspace.

post.summary: Create a campaign.
Preview the audience an audience-filter set would resolve to, without creating a campaign.

get.summary: Get a single campaign.

post.summary: Send (or queue) a campaign to its resolved audience.
Apply a lifecycle action to a campaign (submit for approval, approve, reject, pause, resume, cancel, retry).
Bulk-import contacts from a contacts array or CSV text.

get.summary: List contacts, optionally filtered by search text or lifecycle stage.

post.summary: Create a contact.

get.summary: List conversations for the workspace inbox.

post.summary: Create a conversation with a contact.

get.summary: Total unread conversation count for the current user.
Get the conversation for a given contact.
Delivery/read receipt info for a single message.
List messages in a conversation, paginated.

patch.summary: Mark a message as delivered or read.

delete.summary: Delete a message (for me / for everyone, per mode).

post.summary: Delete a message (POST alias of the DELETE route above, for clients that can't send a DELETE body).
Delete a message by id in the request body.

get.summary: Get a single conversation.

post.summary: Add the conversation's contact to the CRM board at a given stage.

patch.summary: Assign or unassign a conversation to a team member.

post.summary: Send a WhatsApp template message into a conversation.
Send a free-form text/attachment message into a conversation.
Add an internal note to a conversation.

get.summary: Home dashboard summary - KPIs, message volume, agent performance, team workload, recent conversations, health.
Backend ops/diagnostics snapshot - health, feature flags, queue status, capabilities. Not used by any client UI.

post.summary: Enqueue a test job on the maintenance queue.
Publish a test event to the RabbitMQ event bus.

get.summary: Public terms of service page.
Public data deletion instructions page (required by Meta app review).

post.summary: Upload a base64-encoded media attachment.

get.summary: Workspace settings snapshot - WhatsApp accounts, templates, roles, integrations.

put.summary: Update third-party integration config (webhook, Google Sheets, AI providers, email, SMS).

post.summary: Send a real test payload to a configured outbound webhook URL.

get.summary: List tasks, optionally filtered by status or assignee.

post.summary: Create a task.

patch.summary: Update a task (sparse update, including status).

get.summary: List team members.

post.summary: Invite a new team member.

get.summary: List message templates, optionally filtered by type/status/category/language/search.

post.summary: Create a message template.
Render a template body with sample variables, without saving anything.
Pull the latest template list/status from the WhatsApp provider for an account.

get.summary: Get a single template.

post.summary: Duplicate a template as a new draft.
Record that a template was used (increments usage stats).

get.summary: List connected WhatsApp Business accounts.

post.summary: Connect a WhatsApp Business account (Meta, Twilio, or Wati).

get.summary: WhatsApp provider health, message/template stats, and recent activity.
List provider-side templates for an account.

post.summary: Submit a new template to the WhatsApp provider for approval.
Pull the latest template list/status from the provider for an account.
Send a real test message through the account's provider to verify credentials.

get.summary: Meta webhook verification handshake (hub.challenge), gated by the configured verify token, not Bearer auth.

post.summary: Meta inbound webhook (messages, statuses). Verified via X-Hub-Signature-256 HMAC, not Bearer auth.
Twilio inbound webhook (messages, statuses). Provider-verified, not Bearer auth.
Wati inbound webhook (messages, statuses). Provider-verified, not Bearer auth.

get.summary: Get the current workspace.

post.summary: Create a new workspace under the current organization.
